items.title: Nvidia, Apple, Broadcom in 'fierce' battle to make chips at TSMC
items.author: Katie Tarasov
items.highlights: As Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co.'s Add To Watchlist record quarter makes clear, demand from chipmakers shows no sign of slowing down. In fact, TSMC can't manufacture quickly enough. The artificial intelligence boom has created unending need for space on factory lines at the world's leading chip manufacturer, and it could put a chokehold on the entire industry's ability to scale. Last year, TSMC said it had the capacity to make more than 17 million 12-inch equivalent wafers. But customers want more. items.title: Taiwan Semiconductor Just Became Even More of an AI Anchor On Nvidia's -25% Plummet - 24/7 Wall St.
items.author: Alex Sirois
items.highlights: Growth keeps showing up in earnings as well. Third-quarter EPS came in at $4.60 against a consensus of $4.46. Management raised its full-year forecast to about 44% revenue growth in U.S. dollars, up from slightly above 40%. October revenue rose 59.7% year over year. I also still get a reasonable price and a growing income stream. Shares trade at a forward P/E of 18. The quarterly ADR dividend rose from $0.683789 in April 2025 to $1.366286 declared on November 10, 2026. Management also reaffirmed its goal of “a sustainable and steadily increasing cash dividend per share”.

items.title: 台積電（TSMC）2026年第三季財報後，Nvidia（NVDA）與AMD的展望：2奈米製程量產與高效能運算（HPC）需求激增對兩檔股票的意義
items.author: MEXC 研究團隊
items.highlights: 台積電2026年第三季營收、獲利及第四季財測優於預期，但對GPU股票的影響好壞參半：2奈米占營收8%證實了AMD的MI450量產，HPC成長22%證實了Nvidia的需求，而CoWoS產能仍未量化。 ... - 台積電2026年第三季業績（2026年10月15日）在營收、獲利及財測方面均優於預期。本文探討這份財報對Nvidia和AMD的意義；台積電完整業績另文報導。 - 新資訊好壞參半。2奈米占晶圓營收比重從第二季的3%升至第三季的8%，HPC占營收比重達68%，季增22%。毛利率為66.4%，較第二季下滑1.3個百分點，台積電將其歸因於2奈米初期量產。 - 在法說會上，台積電預估第四季營收為523億至543億美元（以中點計算年增58%），將2026年成長展望上調至約44%，表示AI需求「高於供給」，並表示2奈米產能到2027年將成長逾一倍。台積電未提供CoWoS產能數字。 - 對Nvidia（NVDA）而言：需求獲得證實，封裝供給仍未量化。對AMD而言：2奈米量產及2027年產能倍增是第三方首次證實其MI450節點。兩檔股票10月15日仍因AI資本支出回報疑慮引發的整體類股拋售而下跌，並非受台積電數據影響。 ... 根據 3Q26管理層報告：營收為467.2億美元，高於446億至458億美元的財測；淨利為新台幣7,630.6億元，年增68.7%，優於市場共識；毛利率為66.4%
